title: 第15章 大好生意第16章 一份遗嘱
lines: 第15章大好生意
环贸大厦，卫桓那间办公室外，邹玲在曲灵对面的长沙发上坐的笔直。
她是上午十点多钟接到这位曲秘书的电话，邀请她来竞标环贸集团法律顾问，这很平常，她的律所在滨海市排不进前五，前十那是稳稳的，常常接到这样的邀请电话。
可这个邀请，让她立刻就到，不给半点准备时间，她还真是头一回碰到。
从进了环贸大厦，站到这扇门外，到现在……邹玲瞄了眼手表，已经下午两点半了，除了那位曲秘书隔上几分钟十几分钟叫个人进去，别的就什么也没有了，没人关心他们中午饭吃没吃，别提中午饭了，连水都没有，确切的说，连句请坐下等，都没听到。刚到的时候，挤了十几二十多人，她连站都站的远远的，好在现在有地方坐了。
“邹小姐。”曲灵的话打断了邹玲的胡思乱想，邹玲急忙站起来，拉了拉衣服，冲曲灵得体的微笑点了下头，迎着从门里出来的另一家律师代表，进了办公室。
卫桓坐在那幅几乎占了整面墙的巨幅牡丹图前的沙发上，两只胳膊往后搭在沙发背上，脸上看不出什么表情，冷冷看着冲着他走过来的邹玲。
卫桓面前的大理石茶几上，扔满了各家的精美简介。
邹玲被卫桓阴冷的目光看的浑身不自在，走到离茶几五六步，看了眼茶几上那堆凌乱不堪，甚至有几本掉到地上的简介，下巴微抬，迎上了卫桓的目光，“我是十一点半到您办公室门外的，等到一点，我就不打算再做环贸的生意了。之所以一直等到现在，是有几句话，要和卫老板说。”
卫桓眉梢微抬。
“我们和客户，是合作伙伴，您一个电话过去，要求我们立刻过来，这勉强能归在客户需求紧急的范畴内。
可我们到了贵公司，贵公司连最起码的礼仪都没有，我在您办公室门外站了一个小时，坐了两个小时，这中间，没有人关心我的中午饭怎么办，甚至没有人给我哪怕一瓶水。”
卫桓一个怔神，中午饭？水？呃，他忘了他们这些凡人无数麻烦的需求了。
“对不起。”卫桓一句对不起说的极其干脆。
邹玲有几分意外，“我接受，那告辞了。”
“等等。”卫桓叫住邹玲，抬起左手握着的一张纸扫了眼，“你姓邹？环贸的法律事宜，我想委托给邹小姐。”
没等邹玲答话，卫桓接着道：“刚才的事，不是不尊重合作伙伴，是我疏忽了。”
邹玲等到最后，对拿到这单生意，已经不抱希望了，这几句峰回路转，让她有一种年会中大奖的感觉。
“请坐。”卫桓站起来，示意邹玲坐，自己走到旁边吧台旁，“你喝什么？红酒？”
“有苏打水最好，我开车来的。”邹玲忙答道。
卫桓嗯了一声，倒了半杯红酒，又给邹玲倒了杯苏打水。
“要签份合同是吧？这也是法律事宜，请邹小姐提前介入，先拟这份合同吧，该盖什么章，或是要签字，告诉曲灵就行。”卫桓重又坐回沙发。
邹玲被他这几句话说的有几分呆滞，这什么意思？条件全由她定？
“眼下有点儿小麻烦，我收购环贸的资金，需要解释来源。”卫桓看着邹玲，直截了当道。
邹玲差点噎着，这话什么意思？他收购环贸的资金要解释来源？难道他这资金来源不明？
“卫老板的资金来源有问题？那来源？”

Chapter 15 Great Business
Outside Wei Huan's office in the Huanmao Building, Zou Ling sat upright on the couch opposite Qu Ling.
She received a call from Secretary Qu at about ten o'clock in the morning, inviting her to bid for the legal counsel of the Huantao Group. This was very common. Her law firm was not among the top five in Binhai City, but it was firmly in the top ten. She often received invitation calls like this.
But this invitation asked her to arrive immediately without giving any time to prepare. This was really the first time she had encountered it.
From the moment she entered the International Trade Building and stood outside this door, until now... Zou Ling glanced at her watch. It was already half past two in the afternoon. Except for Secretary Qu calling someone in every few minutes or ten, there was nothing else. No one cared whether they had lunch or not. Not to mention lunch, there was not even water. To be precise, they didn't even hear a word about please sit down and wait. When she first arrived, there were more than ten or twenty people crowded in. She even stood far away. Fortunately, she now had a place to sit.
"Miss Zou." Qu Ling's words interrupted Zou Ling's random thoughts. Zou Ling stood up quickly, pulled up her clothes, nodded at Qu Ling's decent smile, and entered the office as another lawyer representative came out of the door.
Wei Huan sat on the sofa in front of the huge peony painting that almost occupied the entire wall. He put his arms back on the back of the sofa. There was no expression on his face. He looked coldly at Zou Ling who was walking towards him.
The marble coffee table in front of Wei Huan was filled with exquisite profiles of various companies.
Zou Ling felt uncomfortable under Wei Huan's cold gaze. She walked five or six steps away from the coffee table and glanced at the messy pile of brief introductions on the coffee table. Some of them even fell to the ground. She raised her chin slightly and met Wei Huan's gaze. "I arrived outside your office at half past eleven. By one o'clock, I don't plan to do the environmental trade business anymore. The reason why I have waited until now is because I have a few words to say to Boss Wei."
Wei Huan raised his eyebrows slightly.
"We and our customers are partners. If you call us and ask us to come over immediately, this can barely be classified as an urgent customer demand.
But when we arrived at your company, you didn't even have the most basic etiquette. I stood outside your office door for an hour and sat for two hours. During this time, no one cared about what I would do for lunch, and no one even gave me a bottle of water. "
Wei Huan was stunned, lunch? water? Well, he forgot about the countless troublesome needs of mortals like them.
"I'm sorry." Wei Huan said his apology very simply.
Zou Ling was a little surprised, "I accept it, then I'll say goodbye."
"Wait a minute." Wei Huan stopped Zou Ling, raised a piece of paper he was holding in his left hand and glanced at it, "Your surname is Zou? I want to entrust the legal affairs of the environmental trade to Miss Zou."
Before Zou Ling could answer, Wei Huan continued: "What happened just now was not disrespectful to our partners, but my negligence."
Zou Ling waited until the end and had given up hope of getting the business. These few twists and turns made her feel like she had won a grand prize at an annual meeting.
"Please take a seat." Wei Huan stood up, motioned for Zou Ling to sit down, and walked to the bar next to him, "What are you drinking? Red wine?"
"It's best to have soda water. I drove here." Zou Ling replied hurriedly.
Wei Huan hummed, poured half a glass of red wine, and poured another glass of soda water for Zou Ling.
"You need to sign a contract, right? This is also a legal matter. Please intervene in advance, Ms. Zou, and draw up the contract first. Just tell Qu Ling what seal should be stamped or signed." Wei Huanzhong sat back on the sofa.
Zou Ling was a little stunned by his words. What did this mean? The conditions are all determined by her?
"There is a little trouble right now. I need to explain the source of the funds for the purchase of Huanmao." Wei Huan looked at Zou Ling and said straightforwardly.
Zou Ling almost choked, what did this mean? Does he need to explain the source of the funds for his acquisition of Huanmao? Could it be that the source of his funds is unknown?
"There's something wrong with Boss Wei's source of funds? What's the source?"
